name: WildGaussians
definition: A method for 'in-the-wild' 3D reconstruction that integrates robust DINO features and a lightweight appearance modeling module within the 3DGS framework to handle unconstrained photo collections.
summary: WildGaussians is a 3D reconstruction method that handles unconstrained photos by integrating DINO features and appearance modeling to manage varying illumination and transients within the 3D Gaussian Splatting framework.
